Name: JerryBB's Crystal Piano Music Box
Author: JerryBBS2
Description:
✨ JerryBB’s Crystal Piano Music Box ✨

A delicate melody, a little more happiness for your day.

JerryBB’s Crystal Piano Music Box adds a beautiful crystal grand piano music box to Stardew Valley as a large placeable furniture item.

Interact with the piano to play its special 30-second melody. While the music box is playing, the current background music is temporarily paused so you can enjoy the melody on its own. Once the melody ends, the background music naturally returns.

The piano also carries a small blessing.
The first time you use it each day, you will receive a random Luck bonus from +1 to +5 that lasts for the rest of the in-game day.

After receiving your daily blessing, you can continue playing the music box as many times as you like without rerolling or replacing your Luck bonus.


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
✨ Main Features
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

• Large crystal grand piano furniture

• A special 30-second music box melody

• Background music pauses while the music box is playing

• Background music returns naturally after the melody ends

• Random daily Luck bonus from +1 to +5

• The Luck bonus lasts for the rest of the in-game day

• Luck is granted only once per day

• Replaying the music box does not reroll or replace your Luck bonus

• Can be played again after receiving the daily blessing

• Sold at Robin’s Carpenter Shop for 150,000g

• Limited to one purchase per player

• Includes a special introductory letter from Robin


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🍀 Daily Luck Chances
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The first activation of the music box each day grants one random Luck bonus:

+1 Luck — 45%
+2 Luck — 32%
+3 Luck — 17%
+4 Luck — 5%
+5 Luck — 1%

Your Luck bonus lasts until the end of the current in-game day.


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🎹 How to Use
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

1. Purchase the Crystal Piano Music Box from Robin’s Carpenter Shop for 150,000g.

2. Place it indoors as a large furniture item.

3. Interact with the piano.

4. Choose to activate the music box.

5. On your first activation of the day, you will receive your random Luck bonus and the special melody will begin.

6. After that, you can continue listening to the music box throughout the day without changing your Luck bonus.


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
📦 Installation
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

1. Install all required framework mods listed in the Requirements section.

2. Download JerryBB’s Crystal Piano Music Box.

3. Extract the ZIP file.

4. Place the entire “JerryBB’s Crystal Piano Music Box” folder inside your Stardew Valley Mods folder.

5. Launch the game through SMAPI.

Do not separate the internal folders included with the mod.
Simply install the main folder as provided.


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🔧 Requirements
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

This mod uses several Stardew Valley modding frameworks for its furniture, interaction, audio, and daily bonus features.

Please make sure all required mods listed under the Nexus Requirements section are installed before launching the game.


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💌 A Small Story
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Robin has heard an old story about this unusual piano.

It is said that the person who created the music box made it as a gift for someone precious to them, wishing that person would always have a little more happiness and good fortune in their life.

Perhaps that is why its clear melody feels just a little bit magical.

May your days shine a little brighter. ✨


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💜 Credits
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
